subject.title: [Bug]: Dreaming deep promotion biased to stale 3-5 day old content; REM produces repetitive meta-themes; promotion gates bypassed via phase-signal boost

question: Which signal types should satisfy scheduled deep promotion gates for memory-core dreaming: recall-only, recall plus grounded, or aggregate recall/daily/grounded with extra noise filters?
rationale: Current main intentionally supports configurable thresholds and aggregate signals, while production reports show zero-recall/noisy promotions; changing the gate is durable memory-policy work, not a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Recall/grounded gates only
options.body: Require real recall or explicitly grounded evidence for default scheduled promotion and keep daily-only signals as ranking input rather than gate satisfaction.

options.title: Keep aggregate gates with filters
options.body: Keep daily signals eligible but add stronger contamination, placeholder, stale-repeat, and re-promotion filters with live multi-day proof.

options.title: Split by workload mode
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved dreaming-heavy policy mode or documented threshold profile, accepting the added configuration and upgrade surface.

recommendation.title: Recall/grounded gates only
recommendation.body: Require real recall or explicitly grounded evidence for default scheduled promotion and keep daily-only signals as ranking input rather than gate satisfaction.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the weighted dreaming promotion threshold feature that defines the gate policy under review.
